operations.name: health
operations.description: Liveness check (PocketBase built-in).

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Return this operations manifest.

operations.name: app.guide
operations.description: START HERE: conventions (items, locations, quantities, costs, statuses), the locations and categories, and ready-to-run recipes for deliveries, reorders, counts, imports and history.

operations.name: settings.get
operations.description: Currency, whether stock may go below zero, and whether the AI agent drafts reorders on its own.

operations.name: settings.update
operations.description: Change settings. Switching currency relabels costs without converting them.

currency_confirmed.description: Mark the currency as chosen by the user

allow_negative.description: Allow stock to go below zero

auto_restock.description: Ask the AI agent to draft purchase orders whenever an item newly runs low

operations.name: dashboard.summary
operations.description: Home overview: stock value and units, item counts per status, the last 30 days of stock in and out, what needs attention, most used items, idle stock, recent history, incoming orders, stock per top-level place.

operations.name: lookup.code
operations.description: What a scanned or typed code is: an item (by barcode or SKU, with full details), a location (by its code), or none yet (type none).

operations.name: categories.list
operations.description: Categories with how many active items each has, and the icons a category can use.

operations.name: categories.add
operations.description: Add a category.

icon.description: Icon name from categories.list icons (default package)

operations.name: categories.update
operations.description: Rename a category, change its icon or its position.

icon.description: Icon name from the curated set

operations.name: categories.delete
operations.description: Delete a category; its items become uncategorized. preview=true shows how many items that affects.

operations.name: map.get
operations.description: The Home stockroom map: every place (kind, parent, depth, map layout {x, z, w, d} or null for automatic, own items, units and value), the items stored anywhere plus out-of-stock items with a home place (status, on hand, reorder point, target), stock by place, and status counts.

operations.name: locations.list
operations.description: Every location as a tree with code, kind, path, and the items, units and value stored in it (its own and including the places inside it).

operations.name: locations.get
operations.description: One location: where it sits, the places inside it, and every item stored in it or inside it with quantities.

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

operations.name: locations.add
operations.description: Add a location (a site, room, shelf, bin...). It gets a scannable code (LOC-002...) unless one is given. Places nest by size (app.guide place_holds): a place must fit inside its parent, e.g. no vehicle inside a box.

parent.description: The location it sits inside (empty for top level)

code.description: Scannable code (no spaces, unique); leave out for automatic LOC-001 numbering

operations.name: locations.update
operations.description: Rename or move a location, or change its kind, code or notes. The nesting rules apply both ways: it must fit its parent, and a new kind must still hold what is inside it.

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

parent.description: New parent location (empty for top level)

operations.name: locations.place
operations.description: Set where a place stands on the Home stockroom map and how big it is (map units of about a metre), or reset it to the automatic layout. x, z: the centre (top-level: on the floor; inside another place: from that place's far corner). w, d: width and depth (left out: kept; empty: automatic, as big as its contents need). Refused, with the reason, when it would overlap a sized place in the same space, stand outside a sized space, or sit inside furniture. all=true with reset=true resets every place.

location.description: Location to place (not needed with all=true)

x.description: Centre across, a plain number like 4 or -2.5

z.description: Centre deep, a plain number like 0 or 6.5

w.description: Width (empty: the size its contents need)

operations.name: locations.arrange
operations.description: Set the map layout of several places at once, all or nothing (what arrange mode saves): positions is a JSON list of {location, x, z, w?, d?} or {location, reset: true}, with x, z, w, d as in locations.place. Refused as a whole, with the reason, when two sized places would overlap in the same space, a place would stand outside a sized space, or a place sits inside furniture.

operations.name: locations.delete
operations.description: Delete an empty location. Places inside it move up a level; its history entries are removed. Refused while it holds stock. preview=true shows the effect.

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

operations.name: suppliers.list
operations.description: Suppliers with contact details, lead time, how many items they supply, open orders and the last order date.

operations.name: suppliers.get
operations.description: One supplier with the items it supplies (with stock figures) and its latest orders.

operations.name: suppliers.add
operations.description: Add a supplier.

lead_time_days.description: Usual days from ordering to delivery

operations.name: suppliers.update
operations.description: Change a supplier's details.

lead_time_days.description: Usual days from ordering to delivery

operations.name: suppliers.delete
operations.description: Delete a supplier. Its items and orders stay, without a supplier. preview=true shows the effect.

operations.name: items.list
operations.description: Items with on hand, incoming, status, value, usage, days left and reorder suggestion, plus counts per status. Filters combine.

q.description: Search name, SKU, barcode or description

category.description: Category name or id; none for uncategorized

location.description: Only items stored here (and inside it)

include_sub.description: With location: include places inside it (default true)

supplier.description: Supplier name or id; none for no supplier

operations.name: items.get
operations.description: One item in full: stock per location, barcodes, open order lines, the last 25 history entries, 90 days of on-hand levels, usage and reorder figures.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: items.add
operations.description: Add an item, with barcodes and opening stock in one go. Returns the item.

location.description: Where the opening quantity is (required with qty unless default_location is given)

sku.description: SKU (no spaces). Leave out for automatic SKU-0001 numbering

category.description: Category name or id; empty for none

unit.description: Unit it is counted in, e.g. pcs, box, roll, kg (default pcs)

fractional.description: Counted in part units (kg, m, L) instead of whole units

min_qty.description: Reorder point: at or below this it is low and needs reordering (0 = no alert)

max_qty.description: Target level, above the reorder point: reorders fill up to this (0, or not above min_qty: twice the reorder point)

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit in the app currency, up to 4 decimals, e.g. 2.35

supplier.description: Usual supplier name or id; empty for none

lead_time_days.description: Days from ordering to delivery (overrides the supplier lead time)

default_location.description: Home location (where stock goes by default): id, code, name or path

barcode.description: One barcode to add (EAN, UPC, Code 128 or QR text)

barcodes.description: Several barcodes to add, JSON list of strings

photo_path.description: Absolute path of a photo file to use as the item photo

operations.name: items.update
operations.description: Change an item's details (not its quantity: use the stock operations). barcode/barcodes add codes; remove_photo clears the photo.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

sku.description: SKU (no spaces). Leave out for automatic SKU-0001 numbering

category.description: Category name or id; empty for none

unit.description: Unit it is counted in, e.g. pcs, box, roll, kg (default pcs)

fractional.description: Counted in part units (kg, m, L) instead of whole units

min_qty.description: Reorder point: at or below this it is low and needs reordering (0 = no alert)

max_qty.description: Target level, above the reorder point: reorders fill up to this (0, or not above min_qty: twice the reorder point)

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit in the app currency, up to 4 decimals, e.g. 2.35

supplier.description: Usual supplier name or id; empty for none

lead_time_days.description: Days from ordering to delivery (overrides the supplier lead time)

default_location.description: Home location (where stock goes by default): id, code, name or path

barcode.description: One barcode to add (EAN, UPC, Code 128 or QR text)

barcodes.description: Several barcodes to add, JSON list of strings

photo_path.description: Absolute path of a photo file to use as the item photo

operations.name: items.delete
operations.description: Delete an item with its stock, history, barcodes and order lines. preview=true shows what that removes.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

preview.description: Only show what would be removed

operations.name: items.delete-many
operations.description: Delete several items with their stock, history and barcodes.

ids.description: JSON list of item ids or SKUs

operations.name: items.set-category
operations.description: Put several items in one category.

ids.description: JSON list of item ids or SKUs

category.description: Category name or id; "" (empty) for none

operations.name: items.set-archived
operations.description: Archive (hide from lists and reorders) or restore several items.

ids.description: JSON list of item ids or SKUs

archived.description: true to archive, false to restore

operations.name: items.add-barcode
operations.description: Give an item another scannable barcode (must not belong to anything else).

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: items.remove-barcode
operations.description: Remove one of an item's barcodes.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

operations.name: stock.in
operations.description: Stock coming in that is not on a purchase order. Location defaults to the item's home location.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

qty.description: Quantity, a plain number like 12 or 2.5

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of this delivery; moves the average cost

operations.name: stock.out
operations.description: Stock going out (used, sold, damaged...). Location defaults to the only place holding the item, or its home location when that holds some.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

qty.description: Quantity, a plain number like 12 or 2.5

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

operations.name: stock.move
operations.description: Move stock from one location to another.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

qty.description: Quantity, a plain number like 12 or 2.5

from.description: Where it is now (defaults to the only place holding it, or its home location when that holds some)

operations.name: stock.set
operations.description: Set the quantity at a location to what is really there (records the difference as a correction).

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

qty.description: The quantity that is really there

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

operations.name: stock.batch
operations.description: Several stock changes as one action (one history batch, one undo). Each line: kind in|out|move|set, item, qty, and location / from / to / reason / unit_cost / note as for the single operations.

lines.description: JSON list of {kind, item, qty, location?, from?, to?, reason?, unit_cost?, note?} (max 500)

operations.name: movements.list
operations.description: History of stock changes, newest first, 25 at a time (limit up to 500; more=true means there are older ones). Each entry has its batch id (undo with movements.undo).

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or name

include_sub.description: With location: include places inside it (default true)

q.description: Search item name, SKU or note

operations.name: movements.undo
operations.description: Undo a change: posts the opposite of a batch (both stay in the history). Order receipts and counts follow automatically.

operations.name: movements.delete
operations.description: Delete a batch from the history (and its undo, if any); stock goes back as if it never happened. preview=true shows the effect.

operations.name: reorder.list
operations.description: Items that need reordering, grouped by supplier: on hand, incoming, reorder point, target, usage, days left, the suggested quantity with a plain-words "why", and drafts they are already on.

operations.name: reorder.create-orders
operations.description: Put items on draft purchase orders, one per supplier (an existing draft for that supplier is reused; lines are set, never doubled). With no items, every suggestion is used.

items.description: JSON list of {item, qty?, supplier?}; qty defaults to the suggestion

note.description: Why these orders (shown on the order as the AI agent's note)

operations.name: orders.list
operations.description: Purchase orders with lines, totals and progress, plus counts per status.

status.description: Which orders (default open = draft, ordered, partial)

operations.name: orders.get
operations.description: One purchase order with its lines (ordered, received, remaining, cost), documents and receipt history.

operations.name: orders.text
operations.description: A purchase order as plain text with the supplier email and a subject, ready to send.

operations.name: orders.create
operations.description: Create a draft purchase order, optionally with lines.

location.description: Where it will be delivered (default the first top-level place)

agent_note.description: The AI agent's note on why

operations.name: orders.update
operations.description: Change a purchase order's supplier, delivery location, expected date or notes.

supplier.description: Supplier name or id; empty for none

expected_on.description: Expected delivery YYYY-MM-DD; empty to clear

operations.name: orders.add-line
operations.description: Add an item to an open purchase order (raises the quantity if it is already on it; mode=set replaces it).

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

qty.description: Quantity, a plain number like 12 or 2.5

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit (default the item cost)

operations.name: orders.update-line
operations.description: Change a line's quantity or cost.

qty.description: Quantity, a plain number like 12 or 2.5

operations.name: orders.remove-line
operations.description: Remove a line nothing has arrived for.

operations.name: orders.mark-ordered
operations.description: Mark a draft as sent to the supplier: its quantities now count as incoming. Expected date defaults from the supplier lead time.

operations.name: orders.back-to-draft
operations.description: Put an ordered purchase order back to draft while nothing has arrived.

operations.name: orders.receive
operations.description: Record what arrived for an order (one history batch). Short deliveries leave it partial.

lines.description: JSON list of {line, qty} or {item, qty}

location.description: Where it goes (default the order's delivery location)

operations.name: orders.close
operations.description: Close a partly received order: the rest is not coming and stops counting as incoming.

operations.name: orders.cancel
operations.description: Cancel an order nothing has arrived for.

operations.name: orders.reopen
operations.description: Reopen a cancelled order (as a draft) or a closed-short order.

operations.name: orders.delete
operations.description: Delete a purchase order and its lines; stock it already brought in stays in the history. preview=true shows the effect.

operations.name: counts.list
operations.description: Stock counts with progress and, once completed, their summary.

operations.name: counts.get
operations.description: One stock count with every line (expected, counted, difference). Blind counts hide expected numbers unless reveal=true.

reveal.description: Show expected numbers of a blind count (for the review)

operations.name: counts.start
operations.description: Start a stock count of a location (and the places inside it), or of everything. Takes a snapshot of what is expected.

items.description: JSON list of items to count only these

operations.name: counts.set-line
operations.description: Record a line: counted (the total counted) or add (one more, e.g. 1), or clear=true to un-count it.

add.description: Add this many to what was counted

clear.description: Mark the line as not counted

operations.name: counts.scan
operations.description: A scanned barcode or SKU counts one more of its item (adds a line if it was found somewhere unexpected).

location.description: Where it was counted (default the count location or the item home)

operations.name: counts.add-item
operations.description: Add a line for an item found where it was not expected.

item.description: Item id, SKU, barcode or exact name

location.description: Location id, code (LOC-001), exact name or path ("Main stockroom / Shelf A")

operations.name: counts.remove-line
operations.description: Remove a line from a count in progress.

operations.name: counts.complete
operations.description: Finish a count: every counted line sets the stock to what was counted (one history batch). Lines not counted are kept, or set to zero with uncounted=zero.

uncounted.description: What to do with lines nobody counted

operations.name: counts.cancel
operations.description: Cancel a count in progress (nothing changes).

operations.name: counts.reopen
operations.description: Reopen a completed count (its adjustments are undone) or a cancelled one.

operations.name: counts.delete
operations.description: Delete a count and its lines; adjustments it made stay in the history. preview=true shows the effect.

operations.name: documents.list
operations.description: Packing slips and invoices handed to the AI agent, with status (waiting, reading, done, failed), the file path to read, and summaries.

operations.name: documents.add
operations.description: Store a packing slip, delivery note or invoice (photo or PDF) for reading. Status waiting.

path.description: Absolute path of the image or PDF

operations.name: documents.start
operations.description: Mark a document as being read.

operations.name: documents.complete
operations.description: Mark a document as recorded, with a summary the user sees.

summary.description: What was recorded, e.g. "Received 3 lines on PO-0004"

order.description: The purchase order it belonged to

operations.name: documents.fail
operations.description: Mark a document as not recordable, with a reason the user can act on.

operations.name: documents.retry
operations.description: Ask the AI agent to read a failed document again.

operations.name: documents.delete
operations.description: Delete a document (stock it recorded stays).

operations.name: import.preview
operations.description: Read a CSV of items: which column each field uses, counts (create, update, invalid, empty) and the rows with problems. Re-run with import_id and options to adjust.

path.description: Absolute path of the CSV file

map_name.description: Column for Name: a number (the first column is 0), the header text, or none

quantities.description: set: quantities are what is on the shelf; add: they are a delivery

create_missing.description: Create categories, suppliers and locations that do not exist (default true)

operations.name: import.run
operations.description: Import a previewed CSV (valid rows; rows with problems are skipped and listed). Same options as import.preview.

map_name.description: Column for Name: a number (the first column is 0), the header text, or none

create_missing.description: Create missing categories, suppliers and locations

operations.name: import.list
operations.description: Past imports with how many items each added, changed and skipped.

operations.name: import.undo
operations.description: Undo an import: delete the items it created, restore the ones it changed, reverse its stock changes.

operations.name: import.delete
operations.description: Delete an import record that was undone or never run.

operations.name: export.items
operations.description: CSV of every item: details (importable back to bulk-edit them) and figures (on hand, incoming, value, status, stock by location).

operations.name: export.stock
operations.description: CSV of stock per item and location; importing it back sets the stock to those numbers.

operations.name: export.movements
operations.description: CSV of the history between two days (default the last 30 days).

operations.name: export.template
operations.description: An empty CSV with the columns import understands.
